## Review verdict — ✅ accept

Re-reviewed at `fbcaf1a4` through the declared `review-pr` operation (#3035). Correctness lens, **0 findings**, converged at round 1 of 5. Judge spend $0.5164, 159.4s, one juror, session `f7712a2a`.

**This PR needed two rounds, and the second one mattered.**

Round 1 (at `21ad7e27`) found `prViewFileName` was not injective and that nothing exercised the `readView` wiring; both fixed in `36096335`. Round 2, run at that fixed head, found what round 1's fix had left behind — `impactIfUnfixed: broken`, CONFIRMED, verified live in a throwaway clone:

> `filePrView` (and `readPr`) never checks that the staged view's `number` matches the requested `pr`, so a staged file with the wrong content is silently accepted and the review proceeds against the wrong PR's title/body/labels/headRefName — and since the diff basis is derived from that same (wrong) headRefName, the diff judged is also for the wrong PR, with no error surfaced anywhere.

Round 1 made the **filename** injective. The **content** under that filename was still never checked. The juror confirmed all 39 tests passed with the defect present — nothing defended it.

Fixed in `fbcaf1a4`: `readPr` refuses unless `Number(view.number) === pr`, evaluated *before* the diff basis is resolved so the wrong PR never reaches git. An absent `number` is refused too — it is in `PR_VIEW_FIELDS`, so a view without it was not produced the declared way. The check sits in `readPr` rather than `filePrView`, so it covers every transport including a future one, at the single join point the module's header makes its claim about. 39 → 44 tests, mutation-verified (disabling it reddens 4), 668 green across `scripts/operations`.

**Worth stating plainly:** this seam is what a credential-less host reviews through, and it is what this session used to review the other three PRs. A mis-staged file would have produced a confident, wrong review of the wrong code.

Recorded by pushing a request file to `ops/review-requests`, applied by the workflow from #1476 running the real `review-set-label.mjs`.
